title: Pearls of Wisdom
editorialNote: Transcribed in original order. Spacing, punctuation and capitalisation lightly standardised; distinctive expressions retained.

entries.text:
First and last are two precious words.
First — Sacrifice
Last — Self Contentment

We should realise that the first and the last are two precious words given by Lord Shiva to one and all.

All ends at God’s feet.
Anything to everything.

We foolish people don’t understand this. We ignore going to the feet of God.

And yet get everything, gain everything, including Health — Peace — Prosperity.

Make clear.
You will be made clear.
Mint your life.
Maintain your life but don’t minus your life.
Make clean.
Make clear, mint and maintain your life.

One day man asked God:
“What’s the difference between your love and my love?”

God smiled and replied:
“A bird in the sky is my love and a bird in the cage is your love.”

Remember you are the most magnificent, outstanding, remarkable being God has ever created.

May God Guru bless you.
The depth of your character will be revealed in the way you respond to situation you dislike.

The biggest temptation of life is “to convert dreams to reality”.

But, the biggest defect in life’s journey occurs when “we surrender our dreams to reality”.

Daddy is a great man who spares his life,
Hides his feelings,
Ignores his happiness,
Accepts the pain,
Forgets his comfort,
Struggles at work,
To make us life comfortably and be happy in our life without a struggle.
So don’t hurt daddy, pat gentle daddy.

A mind in peace is heaven.
A mind in pieces is hell.

We should watch our thoughts in our mind.

I love you all
I thank you all
I bless you all

Prayer is where an amazing exchange happens.

You handover your worries to God and He handles over his peace to you.

Millions of trees in the world are accidentally planted by squirrels who bury nuts and then forget where they hid them.

Do good and forget it.

Caste is concentration of energy.
Energy to dedicate to suit the humanity and human tendencies.
To have heart.
To recognize super fine energy which is called God.
Caste is distribution of energy to suit human mental attitude.

Prayer is equal to good time.
Good time for remembrances, discussions and to analyse our minds.
Prayers divert our negative thoughts to positive thoughts.
To do this we offer our prayers as
“I love you master,
I thank you master,
Please bless me to be at your feet.”

I am master.
Master is in me.
I am at his holy feet.

I am this.
I am not this.
But I am this.
God is very kind.

Everyone is allotted duty.
What is duty?
Duty is allotted by divinity. Duty is divine.
Human beings claim but God does not claim.

Be inside, look outside.
Be outside, look inside.

The more you move in,
You get more power to enjoy Peace, Health, Prosperity.

M — Mind
O — Order
R — Regain
E — Entertain

If you put mind in order, you regain.
What do you regain?
Good, and Bad.
Reject the bad.
Entertain the good.

Space — Brahma
Air — Vishnu
Water — Ganapathi
Fire — Surya
Earth — Goddess

Be near become one, benefit.
Become benevolent, bake.
Bend and balance your life’s activities.
God is in you.
You get blessed by yourself.

Your own actions have to fix the present.
But, our past good actions from previous birth are fixed deposits. We already have fixed deposits.

Always see the feet of God.
Activate your action by seeing the feet of God. By this, you reap rich dividends.

Prayer is compulsory.
Bake yourself before prayer.

You want benefit?
You want benefit but, you don’t want to become one.
Become one and benefit from oneness.
Men should kill selfishness, ego and jealousy.
Relax, retain, regain the Dharma.

From birth to 5 years there is no account for any individual.

5 years to 21 years there is a joint account (Individual + Parents + Teachers).

From 21 years till marriage there is an independent account holder.

After marriage, there is a joint account (Individual + Spouse).

I am a bubble in the ocean.
There are millions of bubbles in the ocean.
The miracle is to accept divinity.

Don’t copy.
Don’t compare.
Don’t get into compression and confusion.
We want benefit from Guru but no Guru.
Whatever you do you are accountable.
Mind energy is potential energy.

Silence is Brahma.
Protection is Vishnu.
Maintenance is Siva.

Cat comes.
Rat comes.
Cat wants to catch the rat.
Rat should not run away.
Rat should catch cat.

Ego wants to conquer.
Humble wants humbleness,
egoless, selfless.
True master will always be free, frank, true, neutral, natural.
Master reflects love to whole family members.

Fail Pass Fail
Pass Fail Pass
Pass Pass Pass
Fail Fail Pass

I am a servant to God.
God is serving me.
This is surrender to God.

Study the situation
Don’t seek the situation
Settle down with the situation

People want equality.
People don’t show equality.
Dharma Guru is to be given respect.

Obey the order.
Order is divinity.

Unknowingly you come
Unknowingly you serve
Unknowingly is the essence of philosophy
Baking is the duty of a Guru towards a student.
Thought is Runam.

Dirty.
Don’t fall in ditch water.
Ditch water has bad smell but good.
All Gurus are Dhobis.

Give
Gain God
Go forward with God

Grind
Ground
Grind

Don’t claim
Don’t clamour

Quality outside
Quality inside

Education plays a vital role.
The quality of education determines how we live.
The highly qualified people are simple.

Indian caste is inside.
Western caste is outside.

Be fashionable,
Don’t beat fashion,
Don’t bear fashion,
Don’t be after fashion.
Are you ready to go with the world, or with divinity?

Mix to mingle,
Mingle to mingle,
Mingle to maintain,
Maintain to minus,
And
Minus to maintain.

They are masters
But they are not masters

Help the poor,
But don’t advertise.

Truth is fire.
You cannot touch truth.

Condition corruption and conceive corruption.
Conditioned corruption is allowed.
Conceive corruption is not allowed.
Cheat society but don’t cheat God.

I need discipline.
But, I don’t want discipline.

I need an orthodox order in my life.
But, I don’t want an orthodox order.

We all came to earth,
It is a beautiful thing.
To enjoy all his things in a right way given by him,
To help his needful children in a good and needful manner.
Energy is rotating to reveal.
Fact is a fact.
Sharing is very very important.

I need media
But, I don’t want media.
Time is precious.

Relieve to retain and
Retain to relieve.
Truth is Rama. Truth is God.

Compare inside and outside power and status.
Don’t compare. Don’t copy. Compose yourself.

North & East — Positive Directions
South — Negative Direction
West — Neutral Direction

Don’t attract to attack.
Attract to adjust,
Don’t get attracted,
Attract to accuse.

Don’t establish.
If you establish you will extract.

Continue simple living.
Continue seva in a simple way.
Lead a practical, perfect and powerful life.

When you maintain yourself,
Then you come near to Master.
When you maintain yourself as Master,
Then, you become yourself Master.

Love to lead
Love to link
Love to leap
Love to lend
Love to level
Love to balance
Charity means without expectation.

What is recognition?
You re-organise your mind,
Recharge your mind,
Automatically you get recognition.
Media and charity is not countable.

Over talk and over thought will override your life.
Balance talk and balanced thought will bring bounty of bliss.
If one wants to click their life then move like clock hand.
Observe to absorb.

Be bold
Be brave
Balance your mind.

Be like a dog. Don’t become a donkey.
Carry like a donkey. Don’t run like a horse.
Don’t expand but extend.
There are so many masters unseen, unheard and mystic.

Everywhere is
In everything, at all time, at all places, in each item, see Him.
Seek His Grace. Surrender to Him.

Become cat before rat.
Become rat before cat.
Cat means Wealth.
Rat means Wisdom.
Blessings brings bountiful peace, health and prosperity.

Bake and become one.
Bring near, don’t beat.
Benefit from your life.
Balance your mind.
Bring all near you.
But be away from all.
Best is balance of one’s life.
Through body and words from your mouth.

Base and background are necessary in one’s life.
Base is professional background (economic status).
Background is family background (caste is society allotted duty to oneself).

Account of life
Good deeds and bad deeds.

For ladies not accountable to any level to anything. Why?
Ladies are not accountable for one’s life.
But, they are accountable for every aspect of life.

Correct to connect.
Connect to correct.

Birth to death, all human beings are accountable.
Not only human beings. But, all living creatures are accountable — for good and bad deeds.

Connect
Contact
Conceive
Compose
Cool
Don’t confuse

Darkness goes, light comes called Morning.
Light goes, darkness comes called Evening.
During these two periods if you offer prayers they will remove obstacles.

Society is accountable at every level i.e. happening in day to day activities (kings, rulers and political leaders).
Media is accountable.

Exposure leads to explosion.
Good thoughts like rays affect the body system and brings the fruits of your activities in life.

When you cannot recognize yourself, you cannot recognize others.
You only recognize yourself.

Time is God,
Time is discipline,
Time is system,
Its life and love,
Time is your future,
Time is silence,
Seek time to settle down,
Don’t search to seek,
But search to settle down.

God is silence
God is everything
Dedicate to Him
Dive in Him
Derive Him
Drive him in all body

Do all the good you can
By all the means you can
In all the ways you can
In all the places you can
At all the time you can
To all the people you can
As long as ever you can

Master outside,
Monk inside.

Enough is energy.
Don’t fix and follow. But, follow and fix.

Don’t repeat.
Request your mind not to think negative.
But, put forward pure energy thought into heart-soul.
That means surrender to soul.
Media and charity are not countable part of your recognition.
Whoever controls their mind will become Master.
All human beings are credit card holders.
Change of body is called death.

Time is God.
Time is Energy.
Track your time.
Prayer is perfect when you pray yourself.

Shock, shiver makes a mind clean.
(Awareness)
Change for exchange.

Release to retain
Retain to reach
Reach to reap
Reap to re-organise

I will speak the truth.
I will make others to speak the truth.

Cat & Rat
Rat should not be afraid of the cat.
If rat is weak and is afraid of the cat,
Cat will swallow Rat.
Be bold to face rich people.
Attract soul. Don’t attach to the activeness.

If you expose, you could be explored.
Express your inner feelings, then you extend.

Ego, selfishness should go.
Then only, society will improve.

Time is the answer.
As you seek inner realization, say:
I love you Master,
Thank you Master,
Always, at all times.
If you can withstand, you will not have desires.

The biggest challenge is to be yourself in a world where everyone is trying to make you someone else.

Dare to be yourself.

He carries on
He will carry on and
Trust Him forever to carry on in our life.

Aspire to inspire
Before you expire.

Live simply,
Love generously,
Care deeply,
Speak kindly,
Leave the rest to God.

Happiness keeps you sweet,
Trials keep you strong,
Sorrows keep you human,
Failures keep you humble.

Success keeps you glowing.
But only God keeps you going.
Dharmic life is a tasteful life.
We have something to share — Kaya, vacha, manasa.
Listen to link. Listen to leave. Leave to life.

Fill up but, don’t fill over.
Earn but not to exist, but to extend.

They carry but they don’t know what they carry.
Like donkeys they don’t know.
Be aware that you carry your karma.

Save to speak.
Save to serve.
Save to settle.
Save to be with saints and seers.
The result of this is balance of mind
= peace + health + wisdom

Maya is very very powerful.
Maya is multiple energy.
Be with maya.
Become one with maya.
Bake in maya. Benefit from maya.
Be away but be near to maya.

Be aware that some enormous energy is working you.
Accept that energy, analyze that energy.
Act according to that energy.
Adjust with that energy.
Don’t accuse that energy.

What is birthday?
Birthday means — Remember the past, work for the present, pray for the future.

Birthday means —
Recharge,
Rechange,
Re-equip,
Retain,
Realize,
Reach to relax.
Mercy, grace, love is equal to inside maya.
Forget home in office and office in home.

Look down, go up.
Look back, gain forward.
Sanatana Dharma is not be considered as a religion but, as a way of life that allows self purification and self realization.

Sadhana Vijayate
Dhairya Sadhana Vijayate
Dhairya Dharma Sadhana Vijayate
Dhairya Satya Dharma Sadhana Vijayate
Do Sadhana

Why do we have heart, lungs, kidney?
System is one. But, each part has allotted duty.

Heart gets blood.
It does not manufacture blood.
Its duty is to circulate blood.
Nature has allocated duties.

Karma: Do your duty, understand why.
Bhakti: is practicing the experience of Karma.
Gnana: is the extension of Bhakti and Karma.

Q: What is the difference between Change and Transformation?

A: Change is conversion.
Transformation is change from the heart.
Change is for the world.
Transformation is for self-realization.

Guru is very powerful.
Guru is form with energy.
Worship Guru.

Where,
When,
Which,
What,
Why: Apply correct brakes

He is there.
He will take care.
Always remember God.
Naamasmaranam is the highest.
Mind gets diverted directly.

Love is Guru.
Guru is Love.
Why should Guru show compassion and not you?
Guru is there to teach us to love.

Birth is death.
Death is birth.
One should go away as one enters one’s own house happily.

Care the body.
Cure the mind.
Cure the body.
Care the mind.

Acquire to adjust.
Do not acquire to accumulate.

Correct to conceive.
Correct to control.
Correct to compromise.

Defence = Divinity
Divinity = Discipline
Discipline = Dedication

Charity of material things is division.
Charity of Wisdom is to equalize.
Wealth is weight.
Wisdom is relief.
Always try to secure wisdom.

Shock
Shiver
Stand up
Surrender

Faith should be forwarded.
Faith should not be changed.

Do not claim.
Do your duty.

Karma is indiscipline.
Dharma is discipline.

We are from nature.
We are in nature.
Please remember divinity of nature.

Alcohol is outside peg.
Naamajapa is inside peg.

There are so many habits.
You need sadhana to overcome habits.
It takes years.

Avoid and encourage to avoid 3 things:
1. Ego,
2. Selfishness,
3. Jealousy

Mind is the mightiest organ in the world.
It can build.
Or it can blast.
Impatience in young generation is because of comparison and copy.
Always compose. Don’t compare or copy.

Do not demand respect.
Command Respect.
Do not demand.
Do not command.
But follow.

What is prayer? Pooja
What is tradition? Poojan
Pooja is remembering God.
Tradition is service. Do not mix the two.

Be disciplined in seva and prayer.
Action with discipline will give you siddhi.
Easy path is good thought, good words and good deeds.

A paper flying in air is due to its luck.
But a bird is flying due to its efforts.
So, if luck is not with you, efforts are always there to support you.

Truth love action must be worshipped in the form of Sri Lord Rama.

Whenever you need me close your eyes and look into your heart, I will be there at once.
